review_notes: Foundational bodyweight horizontal press with broad user recognition.
setup_cues: Place the hands slightly wider than shoulder width and establish a straight body line.
execution_cues: Lower the chest under control then press the floor away.
common_errors: Allowing the hips to sag or the elbows to flare excessively.
safety_notes: Use a stable hand position and a range that remains controlled.
range_of_motion_notes: Descend only through the range in which body position remains controlled.
breathing_bracing_notes: Inhale during the descent and exhale through the press while maintaining trunk tension.

review_notes: Foundational bilateral free-weight horizontal press and common primary lift.
setup_cues: Set the upper back on the bench and plant the feet before unracking.
execution_cues: Lower the bar with control toward the chest then press to the start position.
common_errors: Losing upper-back position or bouncing the bar.
safety_notes: Use secure collars and appropriate rack safeties or a spotter for challenging loads.
range_of_motion_notes: Use a controlled range that preserves the chosen upper-back and shoulder position.
breathing_bracing_notes: Brace before the descent and release breath after the hardest portion of the press.

review_notes: Independent-arm free-weight press with distinct stability and loading characteristics.
setup_cues: Sit with the dumbbells supported on the thighs then establish a stable supine bench position.
execution_cues: Lower both dumbbells under control and press them upward without colliding.
common_errors: Allowing the wrists to collapse or the dumbbells to drift unevenly.
safety_notes: Control the dumbbells during setup and return them without dropping them toward nearby people.
range_of_motion_notes: Use the range in which both shoulders and wrists remain controlled.
breathing_bracing_notes: Inhale during the descent and exhale through the press while maintaining trunk tension.

review_notes: Inclined pressing angle materially changes shoulder flexion demand and user expectation.
setup_cues: Set the bench to an incline and establish stable foot and upper-back contact.
execution_cues: Lower the dumbbells under control beside the upper torso then press upward.
common_errors: Using an excessive bench angle or allowing the dumbbells to drift unevenly.
safety_notes: Confirm the bench adjustment is secure before loading the movement.
range_of_motion_notes: Use a controlled range that maintains the selected torso and shoulder position.
breathing_bracing_notes: Brace before lowering and exhale through the press without losing torso position.

review_notes: Common continuous-resistance chest isolation exercise with distinct fly mechanics.
setup_cues: Stand centred between the cables with the handles aligned around chest height.
execution_cues: Bring the hands together in a controlled arc while keeping a consistent elbow position.
common_errors: Turning the movement into a press or allowing the shoulders to move forward abruptly.
safety_notes: Keep control of the handles and weight stack throughout each repetition.
range_of_motion_notes: Use the arc in which shoulder position and cable control remain stable.
breathing_bracing_notes: Maintain trunk tension and exhale as the hands move together.

review_notes: Beginner-accessible guided horizontal press; neutral grip is a Pilot 1.0 assumption rather than a universal machine configuration.
setup_cues: Adjust the seat so the handles align comfortably around mid-chest height.
execution_cues: Press through the machine path under control then return without letting the stack slam.
common_errors: Setting the seat poorly or losing contact with the back support.
safety_notes: Confirm the selector pin and seat adjustment are secure before starting.
range_of_motion_notes: Use the available machine range that permits controlled shoulder and elbow motion.
breathing_bracing_notes: Maintain contact with the support and exhale through the press.
